title: Goofy Yell (Yaaah-hoo-hooey)
blurb: That famous yodel was recorded by Hannes Schroll, an Austrian skier, for a 1941 Disney short about skiing — and it has been the official sound of falling ever since, reused across eight decades of cartoons. The meme era simply expanded its jurisdiction: any person, object or institution in freefall now qualifies. Play it for stumbles, for stock charts, for a life plan visibly departing a cliff edge with its legs still moving. Genuinely historic as screams go, and improved rather than diminished by every decade it survives.
origin: Goofy's signature falling yell, a Disney sound tradition since the 1940s.
